choice-justified:data-table.why: The report's main job is to compare A, B, and C on identical questions and measures so Brian can choose a retrieval direction; the per-question and category tables fit that comparison.

assuming-generated-layout-is-acceptable-.why: The artifact is Markdown with native tables; it has no generated diagram layout or renderer.

long-labels-with-no-review-pass.why: The Markdown title, headings, table labels, and source links were reviewed after the framing edit; no diagram labels are generated.

no-clipped-labels.why: There is no rendered diagram or label layout to clip.

no-unreadable-generated-overlap.why: There is no generated visual layout or overlapping marks.

source-remains-reviewable.why: The report is plain Markdown; its recommendation, evidence audit, held-out aggregates, and positive-control aggregates remain available as adjacent source files.

title-states-what-this-is-and-for-whom.why: The title names Brian, the question of whether linking helps cross-chat answers, and the 30-chat scope.

whole-design-visible-on-one-screen-at-th.why: This is a multi-section evaluation record with per-question and audit evidence; fitting it on one screen would hide the evidence rather than improve the comparison.

cold-reader-gets-the-mechanism-in-sixty-.why: The opening states the decision and A/B/C routes, but no timed cold-reader check was run.

form-matches-job-lists-scan-tables-compa.why: The task is a side-by-side route comparison, represented by aligned A/B/C columns and category summaries.

relationships-drawn-not-implied-by-adjac.why: The artifact contains no relationship diagram; typed-link effects are compared as route results.

same-object-same-mark-across-every-view.why: There are no graphical objects or coordinated views.

every-object-reveals-more-on-click-nothi.why: The report is a static Markdown artifact without interactive objects.

reasonable-line-length.why: Prose source lines are wrapped for scanning, while tables use only the columns needed for the comparison.

theme-contrast.why: The artifact defines no colors or theme-dependent visual encoding; the Markdown host controls theme contrast.

first-frame-legibility.why: There is no interactive or rendered first frame; the report begins with its decision and limitation.

one-primary-drawing-with-callouts-not-pa.why: The chosen form is a comparison table and evidence record, not a drawing.

white-space-separates-groups-and-carries.why: Markdown headings, blank lines, and separated tables group method, score, citation, and signoff evidence.

size-and-weight-follow-importance.why: The title and opening decision precede the detailed tables and limitations; section headings preserve the evidence hierarchy.

structure-earned-by-content-not-imposed-.why: Sections follow the actual evaluation sequence: scope, results, limitations, source evidence, and signoff.

space-and-time-shown-together-when-the-s.why: This report compares retrieval routes in one dated campaign; it does not map position changes over time.

page-carries-its-date-and-version.why: The opening identifies the campaign date and report version.

a-person-would-pin-it-on-a-wall.why: This is a detailed decision record for later audit, not a wall reference or poster.

one-element-dominates-by-size-weight-or-.why: There are no graphical elements; the opening decision serves as the textual entry point.

reading-order-is-obvious-without-instruc.why: The report proceeds from decision and method to per-question results, limitations, source audit, and signoff.

gap-between-groups-larger-than-gap-withi.why: Markdown section breaks separate evidence groups while rows stay grouped within each table.

enclosure-nesting-at-most-two-levels.why: There are no nested visual enclosures.

elements-share-a-small-set-of-edges.why: There are no positioned visual elements or alignment grid.

same-role-same-treatment-everywhere.why: A, B, and C keep the same labels and column order across score and outcome tables.

every-mark-carries-information.why: There are no decorative or diagram marks; all table cells carry reported values or labels.

context-quiet-subject-loud.why: The main retrieval conclusion appears first; method details and limitations follow as supporting context.

comparisons-use-identical-small-frames.why: Every per-question and category comparison uses the same A/B/C columns and scoring scale.

every-encoding-explained-on-the-same-scr.why: The opening scope defines the 0–1 key-point coverage scale before the tables use it; the tables have explicit route labels.

one-highlighted-state-not-several.why: The report has no interactive highlighted state.

object-count-within-density-budget-or-ag.why: The 13 anonymous question rows are paired with category and error aggregates; no transcript content is reproduced.

headline-and-picture-alone-convey-the-po.why: The report contains no picture or poster-style summary; its opening headline and decision state the scope and bounded result.

no-block-of-prose-longer-than-the-drawin.why: There is no drawing that prose needs to explain.

reader-can-point-to-where-any-one-fact-l.why: Facts are grouped under named headings and comparison tables, with adjacent source artifacts linked where applicable.
